result.instructions: Tools for Drupal, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Drupal data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run drupal_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run drupal_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run drupal_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. drupal_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: drupal_list_resource_types
tools.title: List resource types
tools.description: List all available JSON:API resource types (entity_type/bundle pairs) with their hrefs, so the agent can discover what to query. JSON:API: GET /jsonapi.

tools.name: drupal_list_resources
tools.title: List resources
tools.description: List a collection of resources for an entity_type/bundle, with optional sorting, pagination, includes, and a single-field filter. JSON:API: GET /jsonapi/{entity_type}/{bundle}.

entity_type.description: The entity type machine name, e.g. "node", "taxonomy_term", "user".

sort.description: Field to sort by; prefix with - for descending, e.g. -created (→ query param sort).

page_limit.description: Max records to return (→ query param page[limit]).

page_offset.description: Records to skip (→ query param page[offset]).

include.description: Comma-separated relationship paths to include, e.g. uid,field_tags (→ query param include).

filter_field.description: Field path to filter on, e.g. title (used with filter_value; builds a verbose filter).

tools.name: drupal_get_resource
tools.title: Get resource
tools.description: Get a single resource by UUID for an entity_type/bundle, with optional includes. JSON:API: GET /jsonapi/{entity_type}/{bundle}/{uuid}.

entity_type.description: The entity type machine name, e.g. "node", "taxonomy_term", "user".

uuid.description: The entity UUID (JSON:API uses the UUID, never the numeric id).

include.description: Comma-separated relationship paths to include, e.g. uid,field_tags (→ query param include).

tools.name: drupal_search_content
tools.title: Search content
tools.description: Convenience node-title search: list nodes of a bundle whose title CONTAINS a query string. JSON:API: GET /jsonapi/node/{bundle} with a verbose CONTAINS filter on title.

bundle.description: The node bundle (content type) machine name, e.g. "article", "page".

query.description: Text to match against the node title (CONTAINS).

page_limit.description: Max records to return (→ query param page[limit]).

tools.name: drupal_create_resource
tools.title: Create resource
tools.description: Create a new resource (content entity) for an entity_type/bundle. JSON:API: POST /jsonapi/{entity_type}/{bundle} → 201. Body is { data: { type: entity_type--bundle, attributes, relationships? } }.

entity_type.description: The entity type machine name, e.g. "node", "taxonomy_term", "user".

tools.name: drupal_update_resource
tools.title: Update resource
tools.description: Update an existing resource by UUID (partial update of attributes and/or relationships). JSON:API: PATCH /jsonapi/{entity_type}/{bundle}/{uuid}. Body is { data: { type, id: uuid, attributes?, relationships? } }.

entity_type.description: The entity type machine name, e.g. "node", "taxonomy_term", "user".

uuid.description: The entity UUID (JSON:API uses the UUID, never the numeric id).

tools.name: drupal_delete_resource
tools.title: Delete resource
tools.description: Delete a resource by UUID. JSON:API: DELETE /jsonapi/{entity_type}/{bundle}/{uuid} → 204 (empty body). Returns a small confirmation.

entity_type.description: The entity type machine name, e.g. "node", "taxonomy_term", "user".

uuid.description: The entity UUID (JSON:API uses the UUID, never the numeric id).
